company.name: Ascend
company.shortDescription: Ascend is a developer of an insurance payments platform that offers automated payments in financing, collections, and payables.
company.description: Ascend is a modern, all-in-one payments solution purpose-built for insurance. We automate insurance payments end-to-end — from online customer payments including premium financing to the distribution of commissions and carrier payables. We help insurance distributors sell more by simplifying operations, reducing payment friction and delivering the modern checkout experience customers expect.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for managing insurance billing, payments, premium financing, cash application, carrier payables, and reconciliation in one system.
productsAndServices.name: Ascend Insurance Financial Operations Platform

productsAndServices.description: Automates insurance invoice generation, premium collection, commission tracking, and payment reminders for agency-billed and financed policies.

productsAndServices.description: Automates the ingestion, extraction, matching, and reconciliation of carrier commission statements with policy and accounting records.
productsAndServices.name: Direct Bill Automation

productsAndServices.description: Matches incoming deposits and payments to insurance receivables, helping teams reconcile cash and maintain accurate accounting records.
productsAndServices.name: Cash Application

productsAndServices.description: Provides insurance premium financing and digital payment workflows, including payment plans, autopay, reminders, and automated collection activity.
productsAndServices.name: Premium Financing & Payments

productsAndServices.description: Automates the calculation, funding, tracking, and disbursement of carrier and wholesaler payments associated with insurance policies.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $30,000,000, or 10.51% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $64,597,873 to $233,595,124, a 3.62x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 73 (-16 over 90 days) and market heat at 29 (-38).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
